title: ID0415895-DC/Si-D/FR[Y2 / R6 313033014001] - DC2 out of order
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
DC2 is out of order due to issue with EcoG, possible with latest layer 1.4.11 - it's stuck in SLAC phase but no EV connected.
Solution:
Restart EcoG via WebUI

additional_info.subject: Ticket Creation Request and Root Cause Investigation – Sicharge D Y2 / R6 313033014001
additional_info.body:
Hello Malek,
Connector CSS2 is out of service – please see attached photo. This issue has occurred since the deployment of the latest software update v6.0.3-0-g215cb74 (PRODUCTION).
We kindly request the creation of a support ticket and an investigation into the root cause. It is important to ensure that the update does not compromise the operational stability of the charging stations.
